text:
lee: hey folks, first morning trouble. Okta SSO keeps failing during login with error 'SAML assertion invalid'. After the redirect I get a blank page and can't enroll MFA. 1Password also says 'no team access'. My yubikey hasn't shipped yet. Anyone seen SAML issues like this?
martha-peopleops: sorry for the rough start @lee. I see your seat shows 'pending' because we hit the org seat cap during a contractor overlap yesterday. I'm freeing a seat now and will reissue the Okta invite.
lee: thanks. interestingly I also tried from my phone using cellular and got a different message: 'device time out of sync' when approving push via Okta Verify. phone clock is correct though.
ryan-enginfra: that 'time out of sync' clue is useful. SAML assertions are time-bound; if the client or our IdP clock is skewed beyond ~120s the assertion can be rejected. Could you run `date` on your laptop and tell us what it shows? Also what's your OS?
lee: macOS 13.6. `date` shows: Mon Jul 18 08:02:13 PDT 2026. I'm in PST.
ryan-enginfra: thanks. Ok our IdP logs show a 3 minute skew on the Okta node servicing your region — we just restarted ntpd on that node. Martha, did seat free up?
martha-peopleops: seat freed and 1Password seat reassigned to lee@redwood.ai. Re-sent Okta invite at 2612345701.
it-bot: ticket ONB-11234 created: SAML invalid + seat reassign. Assigned to eng-infra and people-ops. ETA 20m.
lee: tried the new link after a full sign-out and still saw the blank page once; then after ~90s a push arrived and Okta asked me to enroll MFA. I can enroll a 'platform passkey' but not the yubikey yet. Is that acceptable short-term?
sec-ops: passkeys are allowed temporarily for new hires until hardware MFA arrives, as long as the device is personal and full-disk encrypted. Please enable FileVault and DM me the device model and macOS build for our inventory.
lee: enabled FileVault and sent device info in DM. Enrolled platform passkey and could finish Okta sign-in. But `op signin` still says 'account not provisioned' after the seat change.
ryan-enginfra: sometimes 1Password provisioning lags — try this quick command to list accounts and force the team URL before signin:
```
op account list
op account add --team-url https://redwood.1password.com
op signin redwood
```
lee: ran it exactly and `op signin` succeeded. I can see the onboarding vault. SSH keys are next; do you want pub key here or DM?
martha-peopleops: DM preferred. Also shipped your yubikey; tracking DM incoming. Glad you got in.
it-bot: ONB-11234 updated: ntp service restarted on okta-node-7, seat reassigned, yubikey shipped. Resolved at 2612345735.
lee: all good now. thanks everyone for the fast turnaround — big help!
